scope: GAME-IO1 independent transport and direct-child lifecycle qualification, not neural learning
bits: all eight A/B/R tuples per condition, delay and declared pattern; duplicate short patterns retained
reset: RESET 0 v1 -> ACK 0 v1; fresh process per administrative episode
action: OBS seq condition phase a b rule distractor -> ACT seq wait|0|1|missing
feedback: training only, after outcome: FEEDBACK seq 0|1 -> ACK seq; omitted for evaluation and broken transports
replay: semantic fields exact; child_pid and elapsed_us intentionally excluded
failure_denominator: each valid administrative episode gets one result even on spawn/protocol/deadline failure; cleanup failure aborts the batch
trust: workers must be trusted and single-process; separate address space/empty cwd/cleared env are not a hostile-code sandbox
